name: WF-5: Pipeline Orchestrator (Comply â†’ Sanitize â†’ Gateway)

nodes.name: Webhook: Pipeline Intake
Branch A: Sanitize Email
nodes.notes: Email body always CLOUD_OK â€” sanitize company names, contacts, part refs

nodes.name: Branch B: Split Attachments
nodes.notes: Process one attachment at a time through comply -> sanitize -> inspection steps -> gateway

nodes.name: Branch B: Download Attachment
nodes.notes: Download attachment binary from msg-api download URL

nodes.name: Branch B: Comply Classify
nodes.notes: ITAR/EAR classification with OCR text extraction

nodes.name: Branch B: HOLD â€” Skip LLM
Branch B: Sanitize Attachment
nodes.notes: Tokenize drawing numbers, CAGE codes, entities before LLM

nodes.name: B: Detect Inspection Type Code
nodes.notes: Infer UT/RT/MT/PT/ET/VT from filename + email text. Defaults to UT.

nodes.name: B: Fetch All Inspection Types
nodes.notes: GET all inspection types from Express API (app.inspection_types)

nodes.name: B: Fetch Type Steps
nodes.notes: GET ordered steps for the matched inspection type (app.inspection_steps)

nodes.name: B: Execute Preprocessor Steps
nodes.notes:
Runs webhook/n8n/python preprocessor steps in sort_order before the LLM step.
The llm step's instruction field becomes the system_prompt for the gateway call.
Non-fatal: errors per step are logged and execution continues.

nodes.name: Branch B: Gateway Analyze Attachment
nodes.notes:
Routes to Anthropic (CLOUD_OK) or Ollama (LOCAL_ONLY) based on comply classification.
System prompt comes from the inspection type's configured LLM step instruction.

nodes.name: Merge Results
nodes.notes: Merge email analysis (Branch A) + attachment results (Branch B)

nodes.name: B: Fetch Pre-Processing Config
nodes.notes:
Fetches 00-PRE steps from DB; builds preProcConfig map keyed by pipeline_key.
Non-fatal: any error leaves preProcConfig empty and pipeline uses hardcoded URLs.

nodes.name: Branch B: PDF to Image
nodes.notes:
Convert PDF page-1 to PNG so gateway can attach it for LLM vision analysis.
Non-fatal: if conversion fails, original PDF b64 passes through (comply will still OCR it).

nodes.name: Retrieve History
nodes.notes:
Query SF-synced Postgres for part history, account context, and prior intakes.
Non-fatal: onError=continueRegularOutput — pipeline always proceeds.
